name: @mercatus-liber/admin-auth
description: Authentication and role-based authorization for every /admin route (subsystem 21). Depends on @mercatus-liber/core only -- never imports Clerk or any other identity provider; that is @mercatus-liber/adapter-clerk's job, a separate sibling package. Declares the swappable AdminAuthAdapter contract (getCurrentSession/listAdminUsers/setAdminUserRole), the pure hasPermission(role, action) check across three roles (owner/admin/viewer), and createDefaultAdminAuthAdapter -- a zero-infra, local-development-only default gated by a single shared ADMIN_DEV_PASSWORD env var, never a production access-control mechanism.
